player_save_control_impact: Existing exact-build disposable ranking and scene calibration stay in force. The host requests native effects, each guarded by fresh process, scope and input evidence. User saves stay protected.

negative_tests: Fail closed on protected/ambiguous saves, foreign map household or PID changes.
Skip unavailable Sims and never retry an unconfirmed transaction.
Stop at the verified reserve or approved spending cap and on manual input.
rollback_path: Revert the named launch feature. No offline test touches game data.
